generation_parents.algorithm: Use a Clarke–Wright-style savings surrogate: score each feasible customer by its round-trip saving when appended to the current route, i.e. d(current,depot)+d(depot,c)-d(current,c), and pick the customer maximising this saving, breaking ties by nearest distance.

The heuristic scores each feasible unvisited customer by distance from the current node minus a capacity-utilization reward, favoring nearby customers that help use remaining capacity efficiently, then selects the best-scoring node deterministically.
